p: the thief cometh in: Meaning that there was no one type of vice among them, but that they were subject to all wickedness, both secret and open.
king glad with their wickedness: They esteem their wicked king Jeroboam above God, and seek how to flatter and please him.
oven heated by the baker: He compares the rage of the people to a burning oven which the baker heats, until his dough is leavened and raised.

day of our king the princes: They used all indulgence and excess in their feasts and solemnities, by which their king was overcome with being fed too much, and brought into diseases, and who delighted in flatteries.
devoured their judges: By their doing God has deprived them of all good rulers.

mixed himself among the people: That is, he counterfeited the religion of the Gentiles, yet is but as a cake baked on the one side, and raw on the other, that is, neither thoroughly hot, nor thoroughly cold, but partly a Jew, and partly a Gentile.
gray hairs are here and there: Which are a token of his manifold afflictions.
heart: That is, without all judgment, as those that cannot tell whether it is better to cleave only to God, or to seek the help of man.
congregation hath heard: According to my curses made to the whole congregation of Israel.
redeemed them: That is, at different times redeemed them, and delivered them from death.
when they howled upon their beds: When they were in affliction, and cried out in pain, they did not seek me for help.
they assemble themselves for corn and: They only seek their own benefit and wealth, and care not for me their God.
of their tongue: Because they boast of their own strength, and do not care what they speak against me and my servants; Ps 73:9.
